name: 3-OH-Phenazepam
summary: The 3-OH analogue of Phenazepam, which cuts the half life down quite a bit. Psychoactive effects are mostly led by its metabolites, rather than the drug itself.

helpfulLinks.title: TripSit Factsheet
helpfulLinks.description: Rapid harm-reduction summary and combination data

pharmacology.text: It is an active metabolite of phenazepam, as well as the active metabolite of the benzodiazepine prodrug cinazepam. Like other benzodiazepines, 3-hydroxyphenazepam behaves as a positive allosteric modulator of the benzodiazepine site of the GABAA receptor with an EC50 value of 10.3 nM.

uses.text: It has been sold as a designer drug.

summaryZh: 3-羥基芬納西泮（英語：3-Hydroxyphenazepam），或叫3-羥基苯那西泮，是一種苯二氮䓬類藥物，具有催眠、鎮靜、抗焦慮和抗驚厥作用。它是芬納西泮的活性代謝物，也是苯二氮䓬類藥物前藥西那西泮的活性代謝物。相對於芬納西泮，3-羥基芬納西泮具有微弱的肌肉鬆弛特性，但在大多數其他方面大致相當。
